preconditions.description: The number of greetings n must be between 1 and 750.
Each greeting must be a non-empty string.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'ab' for c in greeting) for greeting in greetings)
preconditions.description: Each greeting must consist only of the characters 'a' and 'b'.
The total length of all greetings must not exceed 10,000,000 characters.

postconditions.description: The first line of output must contain the maximum size of the stylish set.
The second line of output must contain exactly max_size numbers representing the indices of the selected ribbons.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(index) <= n for index in stdout.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: All indices in the second line must be valid and within the range of 1 to n.
